scripts.data: uv run --with zstandard python tools/extract_rpd.py && uv run --with zstandard python tools/extract_props.py && uv run --with numpy python tools/build_real.py
scripts.simple: uv run --with numpy python tools/export_entrance_obj.py && blender -b -P tools/simple_blender.py && uv run --with numpy python tools/obj_to_simple.py
scripts.blockout: uv run --with numpy --with pillow --with shapely python tools/blockout_extract.py && blender -b -P tools/blockout_scene.py -- --no-render && npm run simple2 && uv run --with numpy --with pillow --with shapely python tools/blockout_verify.py
scripts.blockout-compare: blender -b build/rpd_blockout.blend -P tools/blockout_compare.py && uv run --with pillow python tools/blockout_compare_compose.py
scripts.simple2: uv run --with numpy python tools/obj_to_simple.py --obj build/blockout/blockout.obj --out public/rpd/simple2.bin --meta public/rpd/simple2.json --method "Blender whole-RPD blockout" --pad 6
